name: China Shineway Pharmaceutical Group Limited
summary: China Shineway Pharmaceutical Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and trade of Chinese pharmaceutical products in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. The company offers Chinese medicines in the form of injection, soft capsules, and granules; and other dosage forms, including pills and tablets; and traditional Chinese medicine granules in various therapeutic areas, including respiratory system disease, nervous system, digestive system disease, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, orthopedics, pediatrics, chronic illnesses, and other areas, as well as medication for strengthening the body.
